t: From Code to Consulting: A Blueprint for Launching a Tech Service on Shopify
s: This article outlines a strategy for transitioning from developing technical frameworks like Pipulate to launching a viable consulting business using Shopify as an e-commerce platform for services, while also addressing legal and structural considerations.
sub: Using Shopify for non-physical service sales
Structuring consulting services as Shopify products
Implementing automated scheduling for service appointments
Legal considerations for new consulting businesses (Sole Proprietorship vs. LLC)
Pipulate: A local-first workflow automation framework analogous to Jupyter Notebooks
